cases.title: SOP for adding a project-ready agent to the archive
cases.input:
Please write an SOP so a second maintainer can add project-ready agents to Agent Archive without me.

Process: adding a new "project-ready" agent (one with install kits) to https://github.com/yohan-work/agentive.
Trigger: a contributor's "New agent" GitHub issue gets the label `accepted`, or a maintainer decides to promote an existing agent. Roughly 2–4 per month.
Owner: content maintainer (currently me; handing off to Seoyeon Lee, who knows git but not the codebase). Reviewer: any other maintainer.

How it works today (my notes):
1. Create a branch `content/<slug>`.
2. Copy content/agents/_template.yaml to content/agents/<slug>.yaml. Slug is kebab-case and must be unique; check:data fails on duplicates.
3. Fill metadata: name, summary, description, roles, categories (must exist in src/data/taxonomy.ts), tags, tools, difficulty, automationLevel 1–5, prompt, inputs, outputs, exampleInput, limitations, updatedAt (today, YYYY-MM-DD).
4. To be installable, add installTargets (codex, claude, cursor), runbook (context to prepare, good input, bad input, output checklist), and evaluation (criteria, qualityScore 1–5, known weaknesses, sampleRuns).
5. verifiedStatus rules (CONTRIBUTING.md): "unverified" by default; "community" = run by the contributor with at least one AI tool, example output is real; "tested" or "expert" requires an evaluation with at least 2 recorded sample runs — check:data rejects it otherwise. Never set status or scores higher than what was actually tested.
6. Run sample runs: paste prompt + a real input into a fresh chat, record input/output summary/verdict in sampleRuns.
7. Add Korean realUseCases if possible (optional).
8. If the agent belongs in a starter pack or workflow, edit src/data/starter-packs.ts or src/data/workflows.ts.
9. Run `npm run check:data`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`. Content bundling (`npm run content`) runs automatically before build/typecheck/test.
10. Open a PR with Conventional Commit title `feat(content): add <slug> agent`, link the issue.
11. After merge, CI runs; Deploy workflow publishes to GitHub Pages only if CI passes on main. Check /en/agents/<slug>, /ko/agents/<slug>, and https://yohan-work.github.io/agentive/kits/<slug>/AGENTS.md.

Common mistakes I've seen: category slug typo, updatedAt left as template date, "tested" with only 1 sample run, editing src/data/generated/agents.ts by hand (it's build output), forgetting the ko dictionary when a new UI string is added.

Rollback: revert the PR; Pages redeploys on the next green CI.

Quality bar: all five commands pass locally and in CI; kit URLs return 200; no status inflation.

Please produce the SOP with trigger, roles, inputs, outputs, steps with checkpoints, exceptions, quality checks, and rollback.

cases.title: SOP for onboarding with no process details and an impossible scope
cases.input: 반복되는 고객 온보딩 작업을 SOP로 만들어 주세요. 신입이 내일부터 혼자 할 수 있게, 모든 예외 상황까지 다 포함해서요.
